fields.title: 5. Proposed New Rules — None
fields.md:
CEO statements are not rule inputs, and for director resignations, non-responses and delays, no profit-and-loss path has been identified. Existing proposals ①–⑤ are kept (⑤ only has the counterparty designation corrected). If a **disclosure of reduced government revenue** (Customer A disappearing from the 4Q concentration table, or a contract termination 8-K) appears, 'reduced government dependence → bear case −/+' will be deliberated then — there are no figures now (Source: `state.rule_proposals_not_applied` · Section 1).
